description: Modern collaboration tools often mix AI credits with site or add-on fees, so pricing pages need to explain recurring charges and add-on billing in the same flow.
Nonprofit and other eligibility-gated offers need explicit qualification language and product-specific pricing pages so users know what is free, discounted, or unsupported.
Enterprise collaboration products often surface public-site boundaries in support or service-description pages rather than the main pricing surface, so the page set must be read together.
transfer_conditions: enterprise site publishing or public sharing
